emergent.config.title: Emergent Options
emergent.config.missing_cloth_config: Install Cloth Config API to edit Emergent options in game. Server and manual configuration still use config/emergent.json.
emergent.config.preset.description: Quick-apply a curated set of toggles. Presets overwrite current values on save.
emergent.config.preset.vanilla_plus.tool: Light touch — just the obvious wins. Volatile containers/drops and plantables, plus gentle fire ecology and steam.
emergent.config.preset.realistic.tooltip: Physics-leaning feel. Finite water, erosion, structural stress, pressure-aware explosions, panic AI.
emergent.config.preset.chaotic.tooltip: Everything reactive and persistent — infinite fire spread, reactive creepers, no finite water damping.
emergent.config.preset.hardcore.tooltip: Every system on, no mercy. Expect dramatic fires, cave-ins, and runaway chain reactions.
emergent.config.volatile_containers.tool: Containers holding explosive items can react to fire and explosions.
emergent.config.volatile_dropped_items.t: Dropped explosive items can ignite, detonate, and chain-react.
emergent.config.volatile_inventories.too: Entities carrying explosive items can react when damaged by fire or explosions.
emergent.config.reactive_creepers.toolti: Creepers can react more dynamically when hurt.
emergent.config.infinite_fire_spread.too: Fire spread remains aggressive instead of aging out normally.
emergent.config.burning_entity_fire_spre: Burning entities can spread fire into nearby blocks.
emergent.config.universal_warden_summoni: Sculk shriekers are allowed to summon wardens in more places.
emergent.config.finite_water_flow.toolti: Water does not create infinite source blocks.
emergent.config.rain_accumulation.toolti: Rain can gradually add water to the world.
emergent.config.hydraulic_erosion.toolti: Flowing water can erode vulnerable terrain.
emergent.config.auto_planting.tooltip: Dropped plantable items can settle into suitable nearby blocks.
emergent.config.smoke_and_fumes.tooltip: Fires, lava, and explosions emit smoke that obscures vision and can suffocate entities in enclosed spaces.
emergent.config.pressure_explosions.tool: Explosions in confined spaces hit harder than equivalent blasts in open air.
emergent.config.structural_stress.toolti: Unsupported stone, sandstone, and dirt can crack, crumble, or cave in after nearby explosions.
emergent.config.fire_ecology.tooltip: Fire leaves scorched soil and occasional charcoal or sticks. Rain slowly restores burned ground.
emergent.config.water_lava_steam.tooltip: Water touching lava produces steam that damages and pushes nearby entities.
emergent.config.chemistry_reactions.tool: Dropped items react with water, fire, and soil based on chemistry tags (flammable powders, fertilizers, water-soluble, oxidizers).
emergent.config.creature_panic.tooltip: Animals and villagers flee fire, lava, and recent explosions.
